messages.subject: Changing start values in MSEM?
parts:
Hello,

I hope, I do not bother you too much.
Right now, I try to fit a multilevel structural equation model which works fine if I fit it only at level 1. However, my dataset has a wonderful team structure (approx. 500 people nested in 50 teams), and I also want to include a team level predictor.
Therefore, it would be a waste to model it only at the first level.

Unfortunately, it does not converge when I try to model it at both levels. Therefore, I thought of changing start values but I do not know:

a) how to determine which ones?

b) how to find out to which value?

c) how/whether it works at level 2?

I would be very happy if someone can help me.

Thank you in advance!
